outOfScope: Product runtime adapter BB-066, production sandbox BB-067, SCM publication BB-068 and deployed delivery proof.
General customer productivity or full 20-pair/7-day pilot BB-074; this six-pair fixture study cannot establish those claims.
Changes to packages/**, root package.json, existing outer Jev evaluator, CI or completed task evidence.
Automatic purchase of capacity, operator-written value verdicts, agent self-acceptance, quota evasion and forced positive outcomes.
constraints: Research must compare reuse and the smallest existing-Core approach, inspect primary sources and pin selected versions before READY.
Future dependency plans are assumptions, not delivered truth; worker execution requires delivered dependencies and a current Jev-satisfied plan.
Real-provider and live-product evidence must be identified separately from deterministic mocks; no fabricated API runs, costs or judgments.

Only Jev issues semantic value judgments. Operators supply authorized resources and measured facts; coding agents implement and collect evidence. Neither may author, override or replace a value verdict.
Completion may establish benefit or no benefit; a positive outcome is not required. Missing live evidence, exhausted capacity or unavailable Jev cannot be relabelled as a definitive value result.
invariants: Application owns work semantics and domain authority; Oracle owns source IO; runtime success is not acceptance or publication authority.
Every result binds exact source, attempt, configuration and evidence; unknown effects or missing evidence cannot be called success.
The outer Blackboard schedules ExHarness development only; product runtime coordination remains a separate system.
architectureDecisions: D1 — BB-065 is benchmark-substrate calibration only. It does not decide whether ExHarness creates value.
D2 — Research a neutral harness adapter/execution substrate, preferring Harbor if it preserves native harness behavior and exact evidence identities; adoption is not pre-decided.
D3 — Fix model snapshot, task/prompt input, starting workspace, tool/resource envelope, artifact extraction, evaluator and reset policy before any harness comparison.
D4 — Execution/provider/termination status and independent quality verdict are orthogonal fields; timeout, 429, UNKNOWN usage or budget exhaustion cannot be silently converted into quality failure.
D5 — The common run record must preserve candidate/artifact identity, trace, validator result and token/tool/cost/time accounting for downstream BB-077/081/074.
implementationSlices: S1 — Select and pin the neutral benchmark substrate/adapter seam; document Harbor compatibility or exact rejection.
S2 — Define calibration workloads, oracle/no-op controls, reset semantics and independent verifier behavior.
S3 — Define the common run-record schema and complete accounting/failure taxonomy.
S4 — Implement executable substrate/calibration probes and produce fresh readiness evidence.

researchGaps: Evaluate Harbor as the neutral execution/evaluation substrate and pin the exact adapter seam; if rejected, record the concrete incompatibility and smallest alternative.
Recast BB-065 as substrate calibration only: define oracle/pass, no-op/fail, sandbox/reset, artifact-extraction and verifier controls before any ExHarness value comparison.
Define one neutral harness adapter contract that fixes model snapshot, prompt/task input, starting workspace, budgets and evaluator while preserving native harness execution behavior.
Define the common run record for artifacts, traces, token/tool/cost/time usage, termination, provider/infra status and independent quality verdict; quality and termination must remain orthogonal.
Choose a small calibration workload and repeat policy that can detect flaky task/environment/provider behavior without claiming product value.
Reconcile or retire the existing six-pair DIRECT-vs-Core study contract so no stale custom protocol can become the canonical harness benchmark by accident.
Obtain a fresh Jev readiness judgment only after the neutral benchmark-substrate contract is stable.
negativeVerificationCases: Provider 429/timeout does not become accepted, zero charge or a negative value judgment by code.
UNKNOWN cannot be retried, zero-filled, overwritten or reconciled twice with different facts.
Two concurrent invocations, restart before nextEligibleAt and an expired deadline produce zero unauthorized calls.
Incremental export preserves old records; edited response, forged receipt, mismatched profile, missing Core trace or omitted task is rejected.
ExHarness uses identical mini prompt, model and retry/feedback policy; an arm label without actual Core execution fails.
Jev failure or absent key yields JUDGMENT_UNAVAILABLE; deterministic tests cannot mint LIVE receipts.
Producer success, operator recommendation and numeric gate booleans cannot set a semantic value choice.
Positive Jev value cannot override failed independent mandatory checks or outer acceptance; incomplete cohort cannot satisfy VALUE_CONCLUSION.
Zero API price is reported alongside tokens/calls/infrastructure; no division-by-zero benefit.
HTTP 200 with no tool call is qualification failure and retains usage; missing probes/rows/controlled trials cannot pass V2 completion.
Control/recovery benefit may yield positive Jev value despite failed efficiency; shared protection alone cannot be attributed to Core; INCONCLUSIVE receipt audit is not completion.
Task budget stop with settled usage and independently verified candidate is a measured outcome; UNKNOWN remains incomplete and cannot trigger replacement sends.

livingDocs.statement: Living state accurately describes the resource-bounded paired Core fixture benchmark, Jev-only value authority, actual evidence status and limitations; it never claims general productivity or delivery from an incomplete experiment.

researchEvidence.finding: Inspected start/resume, observe, act, recordVerification, evaluate and promote; mutation requires a new candidate identity and promotion requires current VALID/PASS. Reuse around existing mini driver without changing packages.

Six injectable ports provide a development adapter seam; file persistence must implement load/save. Common executor owns external-effect replay safety because Core act alone does not durably reserve provider requests.
Completed failed attempts are skipped; selected-task runs export after every invocation. Existing provider export rejects growing records. Repair journal and projection rather than discard bundles.
Pinned run starts fresh messages, step queries then executes actions, trajectory saved after a step. No durable provider recovery guarantee; keep outer reservations and count a restart as an attempt.
Use state and typed questions with validated answers/usage. Bounded backoff for service rate/overload failures; failure does not supply a judgment.
Choice supplies selected option and distribution; questions in a batch are independent. Final dependent judgment needs a second stage.
Text/JSON structured evidence is supported; screenshots cannot substitute for textual browser observations.
jev-1.13.0 is documented with input-token pricing 0.042 USD/Mtok and 64k total /32k state-plus-longest-question context. Conservative per-stage byte bound avoids unbounded trajectories.
Hosted NVIDIA models can return 429. This is not evidence of the current account quota, nor proof that an ambiguous call is unbilled.
Current user-reported blocker and selected decisions; missing local historic run evidence stays explicit. New study is independently registered.
Two settled probes, second lacked tool_calls; zero measured executions and Jev input providerProbes:null. Real INCONCLUSIVE receipt is not value proof.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: A frozen request-tracker fixture and independent API/browser/persistence verifier preserve the existing three task families and bind every result to exact source, profile and candidate identities.

A finite provider resource and recovery protocol preserves all attempts, costs and unknown usage across quota waits, process restarts and incremental evidence exports without duplicate dispatch or budget resets.

A preregistered six-pair live study compares the current ExHarness Core against direct mini-SWE-agent using the same coding loop, model, tools, prompts, task budgets and independent checks; complete accounting exposes outcomes, time, tokens, calls and total cost.

Only a real, exactly bound Jev evaluation answers whether ExHarness adds value for this fixture/profile under the frozen rubric; missing evidence stays inconclusive, and worker delivery requires all acceptance claims independently SATISFIED.
